command.autopilotDescHtml: Automated long-only execution of the 6-point confluence strategy on the watchlist + fresh scout promotions (entry score ≥ 3.5 full / ≥ 2.5 half, half-size counter-trend long in a downtrend at ≥ 4, correlation budget + live-ρ half-sizing above 0.9, per-symbol caps, ATR sizing, 4H swing-low stop, trailing stop, TA exit — thresholds seeded from config.json). Daily-drawdown gate blocks new entries once equity falls 3% below day open; limit prices anchor to a live snapshot quote; stale orders are cancelled (entries) or cancel-replaced with a wider band (exits). Paper mode only. Always OFF on page load.
command.newsDescHtml: Aggregated from the Alpaca News API (Benzinga) plus the CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, and Decrypt feeds, deduplicated by headline. T1 = structural (hack, depeg, enforcement, chain halt) · T2 = flow (ETF flows, unlocks, listings, macro prints) per the crypto-catalysts ladder. News is a defensive input only — it can veto or downsize an entry or flag a position for close, never justify an entry below the score gates.
command.socialsDescHtml: Latest original posts (retweets skipped) from curated crypto accounts with > 0.5M followers. Account stats (follower counts) refresh live via the keyless fxtwitter API; a * marks a static snapshot when that call fails. Post text comes from each account's official Telegram mirror where one exists (marked TG — Binance, Watcher.Guru, Whale Alert, Cointelegraph), falling back to public Nitter-mirror RSS, which X now blocks for keyless readers — accounts with no reachable source show a red ✕ chip (stats still live); hit ↻ Refresh to retry. Generalist accounts are filtered to crypto-keyword posts only, and posts get the same T1/T2 catalyst badges as the News tab. Social flow is a defensive input only — it never justifies an entry below the score gates.
command.glossaryDescHtml: The project's full decoder ring — trading terms, acronyms, and dated notes on every indicator, gate, or dashboard feature added. Rendered live from memory/glossary.md so it never drifts from the repo when the fetch succeeds; falls back to a small built-in reference when the browser blocks reading a local sibling file (common when this page is opened directly from disk). Read-only reference — never places orders.

manual.bodyOverview:
CryptoPro Trader is a paper-crypto trading cockpit built around Alpaca's crypto API. The left sidebar groups every tab by job-to-be-done: 🧭 Command to act, ⚡ Trade / 💼 Portfolio to hold, 📊 Analysis to review.

Each tab keeps its own state in the URL hash, so you can bookmark or share a direct link to any tab — a browser refresh reopens the last tab you had open instead of resetting to Command.

Before trading, open ⚙ Settings and enter your Alpaca paper API key and secret. Nothing is sent anywhere except Alpaca's own API — credentials stay in your browser's local storage unless you're signed in (see Account & sign-in below).

Live mode is read-only. You may connect live Alpaca keys to see balances, positions and prices, but this dashboard never places an order or manages a portfolio on a live account — order placement and position management work in paper mode only.
manual.bodyCommand:
The trading-permission cockpit. The Overview sub-tab shows whether you're currently allowed to trade: live hard-rules checks, cash-reserve gate, equity/cash/open-risk/drawdown KPIs, and the last two fill activities.

The 🤖 Autopilot panel runs an automatic entry/exit loop in your browser tab — it stays off by default on every page load, tags its own orders ap-, and has a red ⛔ kill switch that cancels every open order and stops the loop immediately. Autopilot only works while this browser tab stays open.

The ☁ Scheduled Jobs sub-tab shows the last run of the server-side cron jobs — evaluate and watchdog — for your own account, with a per-job enable toggle, an hour-of-day schedule picker, and a manual "Run now" button.

The 📰 News, 🐦 Socials, and 📖 Glossary sub-tabs are analysis-only — they never place orders. Glossary renders this project's trading-term dictionary straight into the dashboard with a live search box.
manual.bodyTrade:
Signals runs the 6-point Signal Confluence scanner across your watchlist: EMA cross, MACD histogram, RSI, Bollinger %b, volume ratio, and 4H regime, each summed into one score. Use the ⚡ button for a quick pre-filled buy, or ▶ to open the full trade ticket.

⚡ Scalping is a faster, lower-timeframe (5m/15m/1h) confluence scanner for shorter holding periods, with the same manual Buy/Sell controls.

Market nests three sub-tabs: Market Overview (price/volume/trend across the whole tradable universe), 🔭 Scanner (an on-demand full confluence scan you can add straight to your watchlist from), and 📊 Breakout (pre-session gap/breakout analysis per watchlist symbol).

Execution lists open and recent orders with Symbol/Type/Side/Status filters, one-click cancel-all, limit-band compliance, and the ATR position-sizer widget (risk-based quantity from your equity, ATR, and entry price).

Every order this dashboard submits — manual or Autopilot — is a limit order, within a tight band of the current ask. Nothing here places market orders.
manual.bodyPortfolio:
Overview shows account equity, cash, buying power, and P&L cards, the equity curve, and your open positions table.

Allocation is a donut chart of how your equity is split across positions and cash, plus a cap-utilisation table for every watchlist symbol — Over Cap / Near Cap / OK badges tell you at a glance which symbols are close to their per-symbol portfolio cap.
manual.bodyAnalysis:
🔬 Analytics nests three sub-tabs: 📈 Performance (equity curve, return/volatility KPIs, rolling metrics), 💰 P&L (FIFO realized profit/loss, calendar heatmap, per-symbol attribution), and 🔬 Edge (expectancy by symbol and by hour-of-day/day-of-week).

⚠️ Risk shows per-symbol cap usage, a 10×10 correlation heatmap, and drawdown/Sharpe/Sortino/Calmar/VaR figures.

🧠 Insights reads your realized trade history for behavioral patterns — day-of-week edge, performance after losing streaks, cadence after a win, and rule-discipline breaches.

🧪 Backtest vs Live compares your live results to saved expected backtest metrics. 🔗 Markov runs a first-order Markov chain analysis on BTC/USD and ETH/USD across several lookback windows.

Every tab in this section is analysis-only — none of them place orders.
manual.bodySettings:
Enter your Alpaca paper API credentials here first — most of the dashboard has nothing to show without them. Live credentials are optional and read-only (insights only, no orders).

Risk Limits controls position caps and Signals Analysis controls how many symbols get scanned. 🔗 Correlation Budget sets how many open Autopilot positions are allowed in total and per tier (Tier-1 = BTC/ETH).

📋 Active Watchlist is the up-to-20-symbol list every scanner, the Daily Journal, and Autopilot use — add or remove symbols from the dropdown, or reset to the default set.

If you're signed in (see below), most of these settings sync automatically across your devices. Alpaca API keys and Autopilot's live runtime state never sync — they stay local to this browser only.
manual.bodyAccount:
The 👤 Sign in button in the header is a single sign-on account shared across the whole CryptoPro suite (Trader, Charts, Training) — one account, one password, optional TOTP two-factor authentication.

Signing in lets your theme, last-open tab, watchlist, and non-secret settings follow you between devices and browsers. It does not sync your Alpaca API keys or Autopilot's live position bookkeeping — those are deliberately kept local to the browser you're trading from.
manual.bodyShortcuts: 1–9 jump straight to the first nine sidebar tabs, in the order they're listed (Command…Settings). R refreshes whichever tab is currently open.

tour.step1Body: This sidebar is grouped by job-to-be-done: 🧭 Command to act, ⚡ Trade / 💼 Portfolio to hold, 📊 Analysis to review. Let's walk through the essentials.
tour.step2Body: This status word is the final word on whether you're allowed to trade right now — it checks hard rules, the cash reserve, open risk, drawdown and concentration together.
tour.step3Body: Autopilot runs an automatic entry/exit loop while this browser tab stays open. It's always OFF on page load, tags its own orders ap-, and the red ⛔ kill switch stops it and cancels every open order instantly.
tour.step4Body: A hands-on paper-trading sandbox — open and close positions yourself and watch the live 6-point signal score update as you go.
tour.step5Body: The server-side cron engine trades around the clock, even while your browser is closed. Enable it, pick an hour-of-day (UTC), or trigger a manual Run now.
tour.step6Body: The 6-point Signal Confluence scanner — EMA cross, MACD, RSI, Bollinger %b, volume, and 4H regime — scores every watchlist symbol so you can spot opportunities at a glance.
tour.step7Body: Equity, cash, buying power and P&L at a glance, plus every open position and how it's performing.
tour.step8Body: Performance, P&L, Edge, Risk, Insights, Backtest vs Live and Markov — everything you need to review how the strategy is actually doing.
tour.step9Body: Enter your Alpaca paper API credentials here first — most of the dashboard has nothing to show without them. Risk limits and your watchlist live here too.
tour.step10Body: Reopen this tour anytime from the ❓ Help button. That's the essentials — happy trading!

perf.rtRowTotalPlDesc: Realized P&L (FIFO matched fills) — same value as P&L tab.
perf.rtRowTotalRetDesc: Percentage account growth over loaded history.
perf.rtRowBestDesc: Largest positive move in loaded history.
perf.rtRowWorstDesc: Largest negative move in loaded history.
perf.rtAlertRiskHard: Open risk breaches hard limit based on assumed stop model.
perf.rtAlertRiskElevated: Open risk is elevated. Avoid adding correlated exposure.
perf.rtAlertConcNear: Largest position is approaching concentration limit.
perf.rtAlertNone: No major risk alerts. Portfolio is within configured limits.
perf.rtCapTip: Current allocation vs portfolio cap. Red = within 10% of cap limit.
perf.rtStopTipShort: Adverse move % for short. Red = price risen ≥3% above entry.
perf.rtStopTipLong: Current P&L %. Live stop is the previous 4H range low (≤8% cap); −5% reference shown.
perf.rtStopPriceTipLong: Reference stop (entry × 0.95). Live stop = previous 4H range low, clamped ≤8% below entry.
perf.rtCoverTip: Open a paper buy ticket to cover this short position.
perf.rtBuyTip: Open a paper limit-order ticket to buy this symbol.
perf.rtSellTip: Open a paper sell ticket prefilled with current quantity.
perf.rtNoMatchingOrders: No orders match the selected filters

gapgo.catStrong: Large {{dirWord}} move ({{pct}}%) on {{x}}× volume — genuine catalyst likely. Check news links below.
gapgo.catModerate: {{pct}}% 24h move — moderate catalyst signal. Confirm with news before trading.
gapgo.catWeak: Small move ({{pct}}%) — weak or no catalyst. Primarily technical noise.
gapgo.entryPullback: Pullback or consolidation at ~{{p1}}; reclaim triggers continuation
gapgo.entryVwapHold: VWAP hold at ~{{p1}} with 15-min ORB confirmation above open
gapgo.entryVwapReject: VWAP rejection at ~{{p1}} or failed breakout of open
gapgo.sizeFade: 50% size — fading crypto carries gap-squeeze risk
gapgo.sizeOrb: Half-size until breakout direction confirmed with volume
gapgo.riskGapFade: Key risk: gap fade if volume dries up at open. Honor stop.
gapgo.riskSqueeze: Key risk: gap-and-go squeeze. Use tight stop above entry candle high.
gapgo.riskFalseBreakout: Key risk: false breakout in low-conviction environment. Wait for strong close outside range.
gapgo.lblAvgIntraday: Avg intraday move on gap days:
gapgo.rtNoHistory: Insufficient historical data for gap pattern analysis.
gapgo.riskNoteVeryHigh: ⛔ Extreme volatility — size down significantly or skip entirely.
gapgo.riskNoteHigh: ⚠ High volatility — strict ATR sizing, honor stops immediately.
gapgo.riskNoteLow: Lower volatility — slightly wider position size acceptable.
